div.head: Duns 1.1
div.ab: Fo se syððan to ðe þæt land age ⁊ hæbbe him ða æscan; ⁊ ðæs on IX nihton gylde þæt yrfe oððe to ðam dæge underwed lecge, þæt sy ðæs orfes oðer healf weorð, ⁊ ðæs on IX nihton þæt wed undo mid rihtan gylde.

Then whoever owns that [local] territory has it [the investigation] to demand [ie. takes it over], and within nine days restores the cattle or on the same day deposits a pledge worth one and a half time the value of the cattle, and this pledge on the ninth day redeem [ie the balance] through proper payment [for the cattle to the owner].

Et recipiat ille in cuius terra deducetur et habeat ipsam inquisitionem; et inde ad nouem dies reddat ipsam pecuniam uel uadium ponat ipsa die, quod ualeat quesitam et inuestigatam pecuniam sesqualteram, et inde ad nouem dies ipsum uadium redimat recta persolutione.
